h: The field which the Lord has blessed

p: The field of Machpelah is called
"a field which the Lord has blessed,"
as is written in the holy Zohar.
And after the Binding of Isaac,
when Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him, was made complete
"And Avraham was old, come into the days"
as is written in the holy Zohar
then he bought the field of Machpelah
And it is brought in the holy Zohar (127a)
the entrance of the Garden of Eden there.
that supernal fragrances would rise up,
coming out from within the cave, etc.
And this is the fragrance of
"a field which the Lord has blessed":
the fragrance of the Garden of Eden.
in the passage of "Let there be light"
correspond to the five books of the Torah,
as is written in Bereishis Rabbah;
that is, the light of Torah
which are the two letters hei.
in the introduction to Tikkunei Zohar:
the Ten Utterances of the Torah."
as is written in the holy Zohar.

h: "Your father the Amorite, your mother a Hittite"

p: עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב (סַנְהֶדְרִין מד עַמּוּד ב)
שֶׁכְּשֶׁאָמַר לוֹ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לִיחֶזְקֵאל
that when the Holy One, blessed be He, said to Yechezkel,
and your mother a Hittite,' etc.,"
surely Terach was of the sons of Shem,
as stated explicitly in the Torah,
and from them came Avraham and Sarah!
according to what our master wrote,
זֵכֶר צַדִּיק וְקָדוֹשׁ לִבְרָכָה לְחַיֵּי הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא
may the memory of the holy tzaddik be for a blessing for the life of the World to Come,
corresponds to the middah of Gevurah —
from the word chittas, dread and fear —
it is the trait of jealousy;
with regard to Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
who drew the holiness and the vitality out of them.
וּבַזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג קפד עַמּוּד א)
and was of the men of his household;
and when Avraham was circumcised, etc.,
who was circumcised with him, etc.;"
